verbosity-slower-general.title: Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
verbosity-slower-general.body: Pitches that are significantly longer or contain excessive personal narrative tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

female-business-success-faster.title: Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
female-business-success-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight current business success, professional employment history, or professional skill accelerate funding.

asset-ownership-faster.title: Mentioning specific asset or business ownership predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
asset-ownership-faster.body: Pitches that explicitly reference owning a home, a store, or other business assets tend to fund faster for both men and women.

female-aspirational-language-faster.title: Female borrowers who use aspirational language such as 'dreams' for their business fund faster.
female-aspirational-language-faster.body: Pitches from women that reference dreams or striving for a better future in the context of their business are associated with increased funding speed.

repayment-history-faster.title: Mentioning a history of previous loan repayment predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
repayment-history-faster.body: Pitches that explicitly reference the successful repayment of previous loans are associated with increased funding speed for both men and women.

operational-specificity-faster-general.title: Providing specific operational or inventory details predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
operational-specificity-faster-general.body: Pitches that include precise details about inventory items or operational data, rather than general categories, fund faster for both men and women.

female-local-currency-slower.title: Female borrowers who include loan amounts in local currency fund more slowly.
female-local-currency-slower.body: Pitches from women that specify the loan amount in the local currency of their country are associated with slower funding speeds.

business-longevity-faster-general.title: Specifying the number of years a business or trade has been operated predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
business-longevity-faster-general.body: Pitches that explicitly state the duration of the borrower's professional experience or business operation are associated with increased funding speed for both men and women.

female-husband-income-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention their husband's specific contribution to household income may fund faster.

female-water-access-faster.body: Female borrowers who emphasize physical or environmental hardships, such as water access or health needs, may fund faster.

female-new-venture-faster.body: Female borrowers who describe transitioning to a new business venture may fund faster.

female-borrower-age-slower.body: Female borrowers who include their specific age in the pitch may fund more slowly.

female-single-mother-faster.body: Female borrowers who identify as single or separated mothers may fund faster.

female-employment-creation-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention creating employment or earning opportunities for young people may fund faster.

female-educational-background-slower.body: Female borrowers who include specific details about their educational background may fund more slowly.

female-geographic-location-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention a specific geographic location in their pitch may fund more slowly.

female-repayment-promise-slower.body: Female borrowers who explicitly claim they will be able to repay the loan may fund more slowly.

female-children-count-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention the number of children may fund more slowly.

female-husband-support-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention a supportive husband helping with repayment may fund more slowly.
female-husband-support-slower.retrospective: Retired as stale to maintain puzzle cap.

female-greeting-gratitude-faster.title: Female borrowers who combine a geographical greeting with gratitude may fund faster.

female-institutional-details-slower.title: Female borrowers who provide specific details about their lending institution may fund more slowly.
female-institutional-details-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that institutional affiliations correlate with faster funding for women.

female-no-dependents-faster-puzzle.title: Female borrowers who explicitly state they have no dependent children may fund faster.

children-details-slower-general.title: Mentioning specific details about the number or ages of children predicts slower funding regardless of gender.
children-details-slower-general.retrospective: Contradicted by male observation that children's ages accelerate funding, suggesting a gender interaction.

female-institutional-affiliation-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention specific institutional affiliations or local branches may fund faster.
female-institutional-affiliation-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that mentioning institutional partners and locations predicts slower funding for women.

children-gender-interaction.title: Details about children may accelerate funding for men but slow it for women.
children-gender-interaction.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that children's ages and education needs accelerate funding for women.

female-children-details-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention specific ages of children or education needs may fund faster.
female-children-details-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that mentioning children's educational needs is associated with slower funding.

female-business-longevity-faster.title: Pitches from women that explicitly state the number of years the business has been operating are associated with increased funding speed.
female-business-longevity-faster.retrospective: Generalized to gender-neutral claim after corroboration in male pairs.

female-gratitude-slower.title: Female borrowers who include gratitude markers thanking lenders may fund more slowly.
